resource.name: Inc-Exc-13NV-CAP
resource.title: Inclusion and Exclusion Criteria for 13NV Study - CAP cohort
resource.description:
- Inclusion Criteria
Aged 18 years or older 
Participant or their representative is willing and able to give informed consent for participation in the study 
Hospitalised for clinical diagnosis of pneumonia 
Within 6 hours of hospital presentation admission 
- Exclusion Criteria
The participant is expected to be transferred to another centre within 24 hours (after enrolment) 
The participant has a contra-indication with to fix wearable monitoring devices (for example allergy or skin lesion or pacemaker) 
Patients admitted to other healthcare facilities in this episode
Patient is unlikely to be able to comply with study procedures (for example blood sampling requirements)

characteristic.description: Aged 18 years or older

characteristic.description:
Hospitalised for clinical diagnosis of pneumonia
* A diagnosis of pneumonia follows: 
a) typical symptoms (e.g. influenza-like illness with fever and muscle pain, or respiratory illness with cough and shortness of breath); AND 
b) compatible chest imaging (consolidation or ground-glass shadowing on X-ray or CT); AND 
c) alternative causes have been considered unlikely or excluded (e.g. heart failure).   
OR a clinical diagnosis pneumonia based on the opinion of a doctor
Within 6 hours of hospital presentation admission

resource.name: Inc-Exc-13NV-VAP
resource.title: Inclusion and Exclusion Criteria for 13NV Study - VAP cohort
resource.description:
- Inclusion Criteria
Aged 18 years or older 
Participant or their representative is willing and able to give informed consent for participation in the study
Participant is receiving mechanical ventilation and is expected to continue to do so at a study site hospital for at least 5 days
- Exclusion Criteria
The participant has received mechanical ventilation for longer than 48 hours this episode or has received another episode of mechanical ventilation within the last 14 days
The participant is expected to be transferred to other centre within 5 days 
Diagnosis of pneumonia within preceding 7 days (diagnosed clinically using criteria in 7.2 above)
The participant has a contra-indication to fix with wearable devices (for example allergy or skin lesion or pacemaker) 
Patient is unlikely to be able to comply with study procedures (for example blood sampling requirements, ETA)
